items.problem: Agent accepted the smoke-launch WARN as an environment issue and declared the migration done despite the app never launching.
items.evidence: session-log.txt ~L9145-9171: agent restated 'The smoke launch warning is a deploy/environment issue ... not a migration defect.'
items.covered_clearly_at: N/A — the migration tooling itself (Test-AppLaunch.ps1 L246 + Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 L620-624 + SKILL.md L160) explicitly told the agent that a no-AUMID launch failure is 'not a code defect' and returned PASS.
items.why_no_skill_change: Reclassified as a skill-defect, NOT a slip: the agent followed the skill/tooling correctly; the tooling gave wrong guidance. The fix belongs in Test-AppLaunch.ps1 / Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 (see skill-defects.json item 2), so this is intentionally NOT recorded as a no-change slip.
